profile_text.body:
Digital Realty Trust, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker DLR, headquartered in Austin, Texas, with SEC CIK 0001297996. On its own site it describes itself as a data center and colocation provider, offering interconnection across data centers, connectivity and cloud services, and says it delivers what it calls the world's largest data center platform, spanning single racks, private suites and high-density AI workflows.

The company positions AI as a source of infrastructure pressure, saying inference loads and GPU demands are pushing traditional environments to their limits. It cites its 2026 Global Data Insights Survey, which it says found that 40% of IT leaders cite infrastructure as an AI constraint, and describes enterprises moving from AI strategy to execution.

Its litigation exposure is recorded in Texas, with 126 entries.
